species.atlasName: Waxholm Space Sprague Dawley rat atlas v4.01
species.sourceSummary: WHS ITK-SNAP label table joined to the staged WHS NIfTI label volume.
catalogNotes: NITRC describes 222 structures, while the downloaded ITK-SNAP label file contains 225 label entries including background.
This catalog preserves all 225 label rows and has 224 non-background expected mesh names.

licenseCaveat: Waxholm Space rat atlas materials are described for this staged handoff as CC BY 4.0; preserve attribution and verify current NITRC terms before redistribution.

meshNamingConvention.description: Derived volume meshes must use regions[].meshName as the STL/OBJ stem before Blender packing; background label 0 has no meshName.

groupNormalization.description: Blank source CSV groups are normalized to frontend group Ungrouped. Source group text is preserved in sourceGroup.

duplicateLabelPolicy: Duplicate biological labels from source atlases are preserved. Use structureId or meshName, not label alone, as region identity.
